play a role: Everyone can play a role in protecting the environment.
每个人都能在保护环境方面发挥作用。
Good teachers play a role in building students' confidence.
好老师在帮助学生建立信心方面发挥作用。
play a part: Small changes can play a part in improving your health.
小小的改变也能对改善健康起到作用。
Several volunteers will play a part in organizing the event.
几名志愿者将参与组织这次活动。
play a trick: The children wanted to play a trick on their uncle.
孩子们想捉弄一下他们的叔叔。
Please don't play a trick on someone who is already upset.
请不要捉弄已经心情不好的人。
play around: The children like to play around in the garden.
孩子们喜欢在花园里玩耍。
You can play around with the settings to find a style you like.
你可以试着调整设置，找到自己喜欢的样式。
play against: Our team will play against the local champions on Saturday.
我们队将在周六与当地冠军队比赛。
It is exciting to play against someone with a different style.
与风格不同的对手比赛很令人兴奋。
play along: I knew it was a joke, but I decided to play along.
我知道那是个玩笑，但还是决定配合一下。
The guitarist invited us to play along with the recording.
吉他手邀请我们跟着录音一起演奏。
play at: The children like to play at being doctors.
孩子们喜欢玩扮演医生的游戏。
Don't just play at being a leader; take responsibility for your team.
别只是装出领导的样子，要对你的团队负责。
a pair of: I bought a pair of comfortable shoes for the trip.
我为这次旅行买了一双舒适的鞋。
A pair of glasses was lying beside the open book.
一本摊开的书旁边放着一副眼镜。
apple pie: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
晚饭后，我们分着吃了一份温热的苹果派。
She is learning how to make apple pie from scratch.
她正在学习如何从准备原料开始制作苹果派。
apple juice: Would you like a glass of apple juice with breakfast?
早餐要来一杯苹果汁吗？
The bottle contains apple juice with no added sugar.
瓶子里装的是未添加糖的苹果汁。
look forward to: I look forward to meeting your family next week.
我期待下周见到你的家人。
We look forward to hearing your ideas at the meeting.
我们期待在会上听听你的想法。
take care of: Could you take care of my plants while I am away?
我不在的时候，你能照料一下我的植物吗？
A nurse will take care of the patient during the night.
夜间会有一名护士照顾这位病人。
pay attention to: Please pay attention to the instructions before you begin.
开始之前，请留意这些说明。
We need to pay attention to how the children are feeling.
我们需要关注孩子们的感受。
make use of: You can make use of the library's free language resources.
你可以利用图书馆免费的语言学习资源。
We should make use of the time we have left.
我们应当利用好剩下的时间。
make a decision: You don't have to make a decision right now.
你不必现在就作出决定。
Let's compare the options before we make a decision.
我们先比较一下各个选项，再作决定。
take part in: Anyone can take part in the community clean-up.
任何人都可以参加社区清洁活动。
She hopes to take part in a student exchange next year.
她希望明年参加学生交换项目。
take place: The discussion will take place in the main hall.
Many important changes take place during adolescence.
青春期会发生许多重要变化。
get along with: I get along with the people in my new class.
我和新班级里的同学相处融洽。
It is easier to get along with others when you listen carefully.
认真倾听会让你更容易与他人相处。
come up with: Can you come up with a simpler explanation?
你能想出一种更简单的解释吗？
We need to come up with a plan before Friday.
我们需要在周五之前想出一个计划。
in order to: She left early in order to catch the first train.
她提早出门，以便赶上第一班火车。
We read the report carefully in order to understand the problem.
我们仔细阅读了报告，以便了解这个问题。
because of: The match was delayed because of heavy rain.
He chose this course because of its practical focus.
他选择这门课程是因为它注重实践。
as a result: The road was closed; as a result, we arrived late.
道路封闭了，因此我们迟到了。
She practised every day and improved as a result.
她每天练习，并因此取得了进步。
at the same time: We both reached for the door at the same time.
我们俩同时伸手去开门。
The work is demanding, but at the same time it is rewarding.
这项工作要求很高，但同时也很有成就感。
a lot of: There are a lot of useful books on that shelf.
那个架子上有很多有用的书。
We spent a lot of time preparing the presentation.
我们花了很多时间准备这次展示。
in front of: A small dog was waiting in front of the shop.
一只小狗在商店前面等着。
She felt nervous speaking in front of the class.
她在全班面前发言时感到紧张。
on the other hand: The flat is small; on the other hand, it is close to work.
这套公寓很小，但另一方面，它离工作地点很近。
Online lessons are convenient; on the other hand, some learners prefer a classroom.
线上课程很方便，但另一方面，一些学习者更喜欢课堂教学。
be able to: You will be able to see the mountains from the window.
你将能从窗户望见群山。
I hope to be able to join you tomorrow.
我希望明天能和你们一起参加。
be interested in: You don't have to be interested in science to enjoy this museum.
即使你对科学不感兴趣，也能在这家博物馆里找到乐趣。
Would your sister be interested in joining our book club?
你姐姐会有兴趣加入我们的读书俱乐部吗？
keep in touch: Let's keep in touch after the course ends.
课程结束后，我们继续保持联系吧。
They use video calls to keep in touch with their parents.
他们通过视频通话与父母保持联系。
give up: Don't give up just because the first attempt was difficult.
不要仅仅因为第一次尝试很困难就放弃。
She decided to give up smoking for her health.
